# Wait for the definition when a test needs a lazy custom-element constructor

The helper is async for readiness/control flow, and its documentation says callers need not await it. The test calls without awaiting, creates an element, then awaits customElements.whenDefined before checking the registered factory and instanceof. That observes definition rather than assuming a completed class import from the registration call. The helper also documents that customElements.upgrade does not trigger loading and recommends direct import() when possible. Preserve those limits instead of treating it as a general async loader.

Scope: Lazy custom-element definition wait and limits.
